items.stem: 짝지어진 대화가 어색한 것은?
choices:
A: You look upset. What's the matter?
B: I broke a flower pot in the garden.

A: I'm too nervous about tomorrow's game.
B: Don't worry. We all learn from our mistakes.

A: What are you interested in?
B: Then you should read many books.

A: These bags look pretty. Did you make them?
B: Yes, I made them with old jeans and shirts.

A: Hello. Are you ready to order?
B: Yes, I'll have a hamburger.
items.explain: 관심사를 묻는 말에 조언(You should ~)으로 답하면 어색하다. I'm interested in ~으로 답해야 한다.
items.source: L5 Listen and Talk A-1 · B · L6 Listen and Talk C · A-2 · 학습지 4-10

items.box:
B: These bags look ⓐ<u>pretty</u>. Did you make them?
W: Yes, I made them with ⓑ<u>old</u> jeans and shirts.
B: That's cool. I'm ⓒ<u>interested</u> in upcycling.
W: Then ⓓ<u>visit</u> our website. You can learn ⓔ<u>nothing</u> about upcycling.

items.stem: 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: The woman bought the bags at a store.
The bags are made with old jeans and shirts.
The boy is not interested in upcycling.
The woman tells the boy to visit a museum.
The boy made the bags himself.
items.explain: I made them with old jeans and shirts. 가방은 여자가 만들었고, 소년은 업사이클링에 관심이 있으며, 여자는 웹사이트 방문을 권한다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 어휘 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 글의 흐름상 어색한 것은?
items.explain: 웹사이트를 방문하면 업사이클링에 관한 '많은 것들(many things)'을 배울 수 있다가 자연스럽다.

items.stem: 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
items.box:
G: What's the matter?
B: I'm worried about Jisu. She is sick in the hospital.
G: I heard the news. Let's visit her this weekend.
B: Good idea.
choices: Jisu is worried about the boy.
Jisu is in the hospital because she is sick.
The girl didn't hear the news about Jisu.
They will visit Jisu next month.
The boy doesn't like the girl's idea.
items.explain: She is sick in the hospital. 소년이 지수를 걱정하고, 소녀는 소식을 들었으며, 둘은 이번 주말에 방문하기로 한다.

items.stem: 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은?
items.box:
B: What are you doing, Janet?
G: ⓐ<u>I'm making a dress.</u>
B: Making a dress? ⓑ<u>It's so cute, but it's so small.</u>
G: Yeah. ⓒ<u>It's for my dog, Mimi.</u> ⓓ<u>I'm interested in animal clothes.</u> ⓔ<u>I want to be a movie director.</u>
items.explain: 동물 옷에 관심이 있다고 했으므로 '동물 옷 디자이너(animal clothes designer)가 되고 싶다'가 자연스럽다.

items.label: [6~7, 서술형1]
items.box: Hi, I'm Maria from Guatemala. In my country, many children have worry dolls. Look at my worry doll. I tell her about my worries and keep her under my pillow. (B)<u>Like</u> this. Now I'm worried about the weather on my camp day next week. So I'll tell her about it. (A)<u>밤 동안, 그녀가 나의 걱정거리들을 없애줄 거야!</u>

items.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)의 우리말과 일치하도록 영작하시오. (단, 빈칸에는 한 단어씩만 쓸 수 있음.) (각 1점)
items.explain: '~ 동안' during, take away(없애다), worries(걱정거리들).
items.source: L5 Enjoy the Clip A · 학습지 5-1

items.stem: 윗글을 통해 답할 수 없는 질문은?
choices: Where is Maria from?
What do many children in Guatemala have?
Where does Maria keep her worry doll?
How many worry dolls does Maria have?
What is Maria worried about now?
items.explain: 인형의 개수는 나오지 않는다. 과테말라 출신 · 걱정 인형 · 베개 밑 · 캠프 날 날씨는 모두 있다.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 (B)와 같은 의미로 쓰인 것은?
choices: I <u>like</u> playing soccer with my friends.
Do you <u>like</u> this song?
She sings <u>like</u> a bird.
We <u>like</u> our new English teacher.
They don't <u>like</u> cold weather.
items.explain: (B)의 like는 전치사 '~처럼'. ③만 '~처럼'이고 나머지는 동사 '좋아하다'.
items.source: L5 Enjoy the Clip A · 다의어 like

items.box: It was the last day of school. ⓐ<u>All the students in El's class could take a flower home and care for it over the summer.</u> ⓑ<u>So Jo took a zinnia, and Molly chose a rose.</u> ⓒ<u>Their plants had beautiful flowers.</u> ⓓ<u>El wanted a rose too, but Molly was slower.</u> El got an aster. ⓔ<u>It was the smallest plant with no flowers at all.</u>

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 글의 흐름상 내용이 어색한 것은?
items.explain: El이 장미를 원했지만 Molly가 '더 빨라서(quicker)' 못 가져간 흐름이다. slower는 어색하다.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: 학생들은 여름 동안 꽃을 학교에 두어야 했다.
Jo는 장미를 골랐다.
Molly의 식물에는 꽃이 없었다.
El은 장미를 원했지만 Molly가 더 빨랐다.
El의 과꽃에는 꽃이 조금 있었다.
items.explain: El wanted a rose too, but Molly was quicker. 꽃은 집으로 가져갔고, Jo는 백일홍, Molly의 장미에는 꽃이 있었으며, El의 과꽃에는 꽃이 하나도 없었다.

items.stem: <보기> 속 문장의 빈칸에 쓸 수 없는 것은?
choices: likes
began
minds
stopped
needs
items.explain: need는 to부정사만 목적어로 취한다(needs to play). like · begin은 둘 다, mind · stop은 동명사를 목적어로 취한다.

items.label: [11~12, 서술형2]
items.box: Hi, ⓐ<u>my</u> name is Jake, and ⓑ<u>I</u>'m a forest ranger. ⓒ<u>I</u>'m interested in forests, so ⓓ<u>I</u> became a forest ranger. Do you want to protect trees and animals in the forest? Then you should not touch ⓔ<u>them</u>. And don't throw away trash in the forest.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 지칭하는 대상이 다른 하나는?
items.explain: ⓔ them은 trees and animals in the forest. 나머지는 모두 말하는 사람 Jake.

items.stem: 윗글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: How to Become a Forest Ranger
A Forest Ranger's Advice: Protect the Forest
Wild Animals in the Forest
Why Trash Is Good for Trees
The Best Forests in the World
items.explain: 산림 경비원 Jake가 숲의 나무와 동물을 보호하려면 만지지 말고 쓰레기를 버리지 말라고 조언하는 글.

items.stem: 다음은 윗글을 들은 학생이 쓴 메모이다. 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 본문에서 찾아 문장을 완성하시오. (단, 빈칸에는 한 단어씩만 쓸 수 있음.) (각 2점)
items.box: Jake is a forest (1)________. He became one because he is interested in (2)________. He says we should not (3)________ trees and animals in the forest, and we should not throw away trash there.
items.explain: 본문의 forest ranger · interested in forests · should not touch them.

items.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고르면? (정답 2개)
choices: Peter likes singing and dancing.
This flowerpot is beautiful than the other one.
The post office is closest than the bakery.
She gave up going on a picnic.
Mike didn't went to school yesterday.
items.explain: 정답 ①, ④ (2개). ② beautiful → more beautiful ③ than 앞은 비교급 → closer ⑤ didn't + 동사원형 → go. ① like + 동명사, ④ give up + 동명사.

items.label: [14, 서술형3]
items.box:
El smiled. El ⓐ________ the flowers in her garden. It was growing season. All summer long, she cared for them.
On the last day of summer, Jo came to El's house. El and Jo ran to the garden and suddenly ⓑ________. Something was DIFFERENT! (A)<u>과꽃에 꽃들이 있었다 … 그리고 El도 키가 더 커졌다!</u>

items.stem: <보기>에 주어진 단어를 활용하여 밑줄 친 (A)를 한 문장의 영어로 쓰시오.
condition: 총 11단어의 한 문장으로 쓸 것 (필요시 단어의 형태를 바꿀 것)
items.answer: There were flowers on the aster, and El grew taller, too.
items.explain: There were + 복수 명사(과거), grow–grew, tall → taller. 11단어.

items.stem: 빈칸 ⓐ, ⓑ에 들어갈 말이 알맞게 연결된 것은?
items.explain: 과거의 이야기이므로 과거형 planted · stopped. stop은 단모음+단자음이라 자음을 겹쳐 쓴다(stopped).

items.label: [15~17, 서술형4]
items.box:
El took the last pot. It had the smallest ____(A)____ with no flowers. "I feel just like you, little ____(A)____," said El.
Mr. Diaz looked ⓐ<u>for</u> El and said, "That's an aster ____(A)____. ⓑ<u>In time</u>, it'll grow and have beautiful flowers."
"But it's just a little green ____(A)____," said El. She was not so sure.
"You can have my zinnia ____(A)____," Jo said to El, "I'll be ⓒ<u>at my grandma's</u> all summer."
"I'll ____(A)____ my aster and your zinnia ⓓ<u>side by side</u>," El said.
"They'll be good friends ― just like us!" said Jo. El smiled.
El planted the flowers in her garden. It was growing season. All summer long, she ⓔ<u>cared for</u> them.

items.stem: 빈칸 (A)에 공통으로 들어갈 수 있는 말은?
choices: flower
plant
pot
garden
water
items.explain: plant는 명사 '식물'(the smallest plant, little plant, aster plant, green plant, zinnia plant)과 동사 '심다'(I'll plant my aster)로 모두 쓰인다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 그 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
items.explain: 'El을 보고 말했다'는 look at. look for는 '~을 찾다'. in time(때가 되면), at my grandma's(할머니 댁에), side by side(나란히), care for(돌보다)는 맞다.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: El의 화분에는 꽃이 없는 가장 작은 식물이 있었다.
Diaz 선생님은 과꽃이 때가 되면 아름다운 꽃을 피울 거라고 했다.
Jo는 여름 내내 할머니 댁에 있을 예정이다.
El은 Jo의 백일홍을 정원에 심지 않았다.
El은 여름 내내 꽃들을 돌보았다.
items.explain: El은 과꽃과 백일홍을 나란히 심겠다고 했고, 실제로 꽃들을 정원에 심었다(El planted the flowers in her garden).

items.stem: 주어진 질문에 대한 답을 윗글에서 찾아 영어로 완성하시오.
items.box:
Q. What kind of plant did El's pot have?
→ It was ______________________________.
items.explain: 본문: That's an aster plant.

items.stem: 다음 글에서 묘사하는 내용과 일치하는 문장은?
items.box:
There are three paintings in the art shop.
Sora's painting is $200. John's painting is $100, and Bill's painting is $150.
choices: John's painting is the most expensive of the three.
Bill's painting is more expensive than Sora's.
Sora's painting is the most expensive of the three.
John's painting is more expensive than Bill's.
Bill's painting is the cheapest of all.
items.explain: Sora($200) > Bill($150) > John($100). 가장 비싼 것은 Sora의 그림, 가장 싼 것은 John의 그림.

items.stem: <보기>의 문장 중 어법상 옳은 문장만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: ⓐ The Eiffel Tower is taller than the Statue of Liberty.
ⓑ Jack is really good at play tennis.
ⓓ Its tail was brown and white.
ⓔ Math is more difficult than science to me.

items.explain: ⓑ 전치사 at 뒤는 동명사 → playing. ⓕ promise + to부정사 → to study. ⓐ tall → taller, ⓒ finish + 동명사, ⓓ 소유격 Its + was, ⓔ difficult → more difficult.

items.stem: <보기>에 주어진 문장이 들어갈 위치로 적절한 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: Jo was taller than El, so Jo could water the plants alone.

El and Jo were the smallest students in the class. They were always together. (A) They even watered the plants together in the class because they could not reach the pots alone. (B) However, in the spring, something was DIFFERENT. (C) Jo grew TALLER! (D) El felt smaller every day. (E)

items.explain: 'Jo의 키가 더 커졌다!' 뒤에 'Jo가 El보다 더 커서 혼자 물을 줄 수 있었다'가 오고, 그래서 'El은 매일 더 작아지는 기분이었다'로 이어진다.

items.stem: <보기>에 주어진 대화가 자연스럽도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 넣어 대화를 완성하시오.

box.title: <보기>
lines: A: Hello. Are you ready to order?
A: Would you like a drink?

items.explain: 음식 주문 표현 I'll have ~.

items.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 동사를 알맞은 형태로 써넣어 글을 완성하시오. (단, 빈칸에는 한 단어씩만 쓸 수 있음.) (각 2점)
items.box: Yesterday, John (1)________ (watch) a movie with the children. After the movie, he (2)________ (sing) a song for them. They enjoyed (3)________ (dance) together.
items.explain: Yesterday → 과거형 watched, sang(불규칙). enjoy + 동명사 → dancing.

items.stem: <보기>에 주어진 단어를 활용하여 계절에 대한 현재 자신의 생각을 한 문장으로 영작하시오.
condition: (A)에서 2개의 계절을 선택하여 비교하는 한 문장으로 영작할 것
(B)에서 주어진 단어 중 하나를 선택하여 자신의 생각을 표현할 것
items.answer: (예시) Summer is hotter than winter. / Spring is more beautiful than fall.
items.explain: 비교급 + than. hot → hotter(자음 중복), beautiful → more beautiful.
